_comment: Floors for `tools/ci-verify-gate.ts`, which the Required Quality Gate runs after every executor has reported.
`shard` names the JOB that runs the suite, and both ci-plan.sh and ci-suite-map.test.sh read it: `checks` for
the three suites that need no database, `integration-db` for everything that does. A value here that no plan
output steers is a suite that could never be required, and `ci-suite-map.test.sh` fails on it.
Measured on main (19d9c88) and confirmed against run 33114090903, which is what these numbers came from.
admin-web was first written down as 290 — that was measured on feat/copy-telegram-id, which adds four tests this
branch does not have. The gate caught the difference on its first complete run, which is the behaviour it exists for.
`total` may only ever go UP and `skipped` may only ever go DOWN without a commit that edits this file.
The 49 skips in packages/migrate are the production-dump suites. They are secure-host-only by design:
the dump is git-ignored, never reaches a runner, and those suites skip themselves when it is absent.
The 2 skips in packages/db and the 1 in apps/bot are the legacy/mirzabot-php source checks; `legacy/` is
untracked, so it is absent on every runner and those cases skip there too.
